monument_name: Sher Shah Suri Tomb (शेरशाह का मकबरा)
popular_title: Taj Mahal of Bihar / Floating Wonder of Sasaram

location.exact_spot: Sasaram town, artificial lake ke theek beech mein

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Sher Shah Suri (shuruat) aur unke putra Islam Shah Suri (purna)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Yeh shaandar maqbara Sur vansh ke sansthapak Sher Shah Suri ka aakhri aaram-gah hai. Sher Shah ne 1540 mein Mughal badshah Humayun ko harakar Delhi par doosra Afghan samrajya sthapit kiya tha. Sasaram unke pita Hasan Khan Sur ki jagir aur unki apni mukhya karmabhoomi thi, isiliye unhone jeete ji hi apne liye is grand maqbare ka design taiyar karwaya tha. 1545 mein Kalinjar qile ki gherabandi ke dauran gunpowder dhamake mein jab Sher Shah ki maut hui, tab unke bete Islam Shah Suri ne lagbhag teen mahine ke andar is nirmarn ko pura karwaya. Yeh structure unke sainik dabdabe aur shandar prashasnik shaan ko darshata hai.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Yeh maqbara lagbhag 1400 foot chaudi ek vishal chaukor artificial jheel ke theek beech mein paani par tairta hua sa banaya gaya hai. Paani ke beech ek chaumukha uncha chabutra hai, jiske upar aath konon wala (octagonal) teen-manzila maqbara khada hai. Sabse upar lagbhag 22 meter chauda ek vishal gumbad bana hai, jiske charo taraf chhote chhatriyan saji hui hain. Jheel ke tat se maqbare tak pahunchne ke liye uttar disha mein ek chhota patthar ka pul bana hai. Chunar ke laal balua patthar par lajawab carvings hain. Charo taraf paani hone ki wajah se yahan dushman seedhe hamla nahi kar sakta tha aur andar hamesha thandak bani rehti thi.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Indo-Islamic Masterpiece / UNESCO Tentative List & ASI Protected Monument
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Architectural drishti se yeh maqbara Lodhi shaili se nikal kar aage aane wale Mughal architecture (jaise Taj Mahal) ke beech ka sabse mazboot golden bridge maana jata hai. Itihaskar Alexander Cunningham ne isko Taj Mahal se bhi zyada roabdaar aur prabhavshali bataya tha. Sasaram Grand Trunk Road ke theek kinare hone ke karan yeh eastern India par nazar rakhne ka mukhya center tha. Yeh poora parisar ASI dwara centrally protected hai aur UNESCO World Heritage site ki tentative list mein shamil hai, jo Bihar ke medieval tourism ka sabse bada aakarshan hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sher Shah dwara shuru, putra Islam Shah Suri dwara 1545 CE mein poora karwaya gaya; Chief Architect Aliwal Khan the.
Aath konon wala (octagonal) chabutra, jheel ke beech floating design aur Chunar red sandstone ka upyog.
1539 Chausa aur 1540 Kannauj/Bilgram ladaiyon ke baad Delhi sultanat par Sur Afghan samrajya ka ailan.
BPSC Prelims ka regular question: 'Sher Shah Suri ka maqbara Bihar ke kis shahar mein sthit hai?' Answer: Sasaram (Rohtas).

monument_name: Hasan Khan Sur Tomb (हसन ख़ान सूर का मकबरा)

location.exact_spot: Sasaram town center, Sher Shah maqbare ke kareeb

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Sher Shah Suri (in memory of his father Hasan Khan Sur)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Yeh maqbara Sher Shah Suri ke pita Hasan Khan Sur ka aakhri aaram-gah hai, jo Sasaram aur Khawaspur-Tanda ke Afghan jagirdar the. Sher Shah ne Delhi ki gaddi par baithne ke baad apne pita ki yaad mein lagbhag 1538 se 1540 ke beech is maqbare ka nirmarn karwaya tha. Hasan Khan Sur ki is jagir par shasan karte hue hi Sher Shah ne administrative aur revenue sudharo ka pehla practical experiment kiya tha. Yeh structure Sher Shah ke shuruati parivarik samman aur Afghan daur ke vistar ka ahem prateek hai.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Sher Shah ke maqbare ke ulat, yeh maqbara kisi jheel ke beech nahi balki sukhi zameen par ek vishal char-diwari ke aangan mein bana hai, isiliye sthaniya log ise 'Sookha Maqbara' kehte hain. Iski banaawat bhi traditional Afghan style mein aath konon wali (octagonal) hai. Iske charo taraf khambe aur mehraabdar baramadah (verandah) bana hai, jiske upar chhatriyan aur ek bada gumbad sthit hai. Architect Aliwal Khan ne Sher Shah ke vishal jheel wale maqbare se theek pehle iska model taiyar kiya tha, jo simple aur dignified lagta hai.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Archetype of Sur Dynasty Tombs / ASI Protected Site
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Yeh maqbara batata hai ki kaise Sasaram mein Afghan architecture Lodhi shaili se aage badhkar naye dimensions le raha tha. Yeh maqbara ek tarah se Sher Shah ke apne vishal maqbare ki architectural laboratory tha, jahan pehli baar octagonal symmetry ka bareek prayog kiya gaya tha. ASI ke Patna Circle ke under yeh ek centrally protected monument hai jo Sasaram heritage trail ka ahem ang hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sher Shah Suri dwara apne pita Hasan Khan Sur ke liye c. 1538–1540 CE mein nirmit.
Octagonal Afghan tomb bina jheel ke (Sookha Maqbara); Architect Aliwal Khan.
Sasaram jagir se hi Sher Shah ke administrative reforms ki shuruat hui thi.
BPSC Special History: 'Sasaram mein sthit 'Sookha Maqbara' kis Afghan shasak ya jagirdar ka maqbara hai?' Answer: Hasan Khan Sur (Sher Shah ke pita).

popular_title: Eagle's Nest of Kaimur / Stronghold of Sher Shah

location.exact_spot: Kaimur Plateau, Son Nadi ke tat par (Sasaram se 40 km door)

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Ancient origins (King Rohitashwa) / Rebuilt by Sher Shah Suri & Raja Man Singh
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Pauranik kathaon ke mutabiq is qile ki neev Raja Harishchandra ke putra Rohitashwa ne rakhi thi, par medieval kal mein iska asal vistar Sher Shah Suri ne kiya. 1538 mein Sher Shah ne Chunar qila chhodte waqt doli-trick (doli mein hathiyarband sena bhejkar) se yahan ke Hindu raja se Rohtasgarh qila chheen liya taaki Bengal aur Chausa abhiyan ke dauran unka parivar aur khajana surakshit reh sake. Baad mein Akbar ke mahan senapati Raja Man Singh ne Bihar aur Bengal ka Subedar rehte hue is qile ko apna formal administrative headquarters banaya aur yahan shandar mahalon ka nirmarn karwaya.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Rohtasgarh Bharat ke sabse bade aur unche pahadi qilon mein se ek hai, jo samundar tal se lagbhag 1500 foot ki unchai par 42 square km ke vishal pahadi pathar par faila hai. Iski charo taraf Kaimur pahadiyon ki khadi dhalan (vertical cliffs) aur Son nadi ki ghati hai, jisse bina sidhiyon ya rassi ke yahan chadhna asambhav tha. Qile ke andar 84 darwaze the jinme Hathiya Pol sabse mukhya hai. Andar Raja Man Singh ka Shahi Mahal, Aina Mahal, Jami Masjid, Phool Mahal aur vishal paani ke baoli aur kuye bane hain. Yeh qila kai saal tak hazaron sainikon ke rashan aur hathiyaron ko store karne ki takat rakhta tha.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Impenetrable Military Fortress of Eastern India / ASI Protected Heritage
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Medieval kal mein Rohtasgarh par kabja karne ka matlab tha Central India, Bihar aur Bengal ke borders par direct control rakhna. Shah Jahan ke baghi bete Shah Shuja ne aur baad mein Mir Qasim ne Buxar ladai ke samay apne parivar ko yahin surakshit rakha tha. 1857 ke swatantrata sangram mein Veer Kunwar Singh ke chhotebhai Babu Amar Singh ke sainikon ke liye yeh safe shelter bana. Aaj yeh vishal qila ASI ke sanrakshan mein hai aur Kaimur ke ghaney janglon ke beech medieval defensive architecture ka adbhut namoona pesh karta hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Sher Shah Suri ne 1538 mein kabja kiya; Mughal kaal mein Subedar Raja Man Singh (1587–1594) ne naye mahal banwaye.
Rajput-Mughal composite architecture (Shahi Mahal, Hathiya Pol) Kaimur plateau ki khadi dhalan par.
Bengal aur Delhi ke transit par military control; 1538 mein Sher Shah dwara doli strategy se jeeta gaya.
BPSC History: 'Mughal samrat Akbar ke shasankaal mein Bihar ke kis qile ko Raja Man Singh ne apni rajdhani/headquarters banaya tha?' Answer: Rohtasgarh Qila.

popular_title: Mir Qasim's Gun-Making Citadel / Gate of Bengal

location.exact_spot: Ganga nadi ke uttar-pashchim ghoomav par sthit rocky promontory

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Early Pala Kings / Strengthened by Muhammad bin Tughlaq & Nawab Mir Qasim
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Munger qile ki neev Pal vanshi shasakon ke daur mein rakhi gayi thi, jise Delhi Sultanat ke Tughlaq shasakon aur baad mein Bengal ke Nawabon ne lagatar mazboot kiya. Is qile ka sabse aitihasik daur 1760 se 1763 ke beech aaya, jab Bengal ke Nawab Mir Qasim ne angrezon ke dabav aur Calcutta ke shadyantron se bachne ke liye apni rajdhani Murshidabad se hatakar Munger transfer kar li. Mir Qasim ne Munger qile ke andar aadhunik bandookon, topon aur barood banane ki aadhunik factories lagayi thin, jisse angrez chowkanna ho gaye aur 1764 mein Buxar ka aitihasik yuddh bhadak utha.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Yeh qila Ganga nadi ke ek vishal ghoomav par chattan ke upar lagbhag 222 acre mein faila hua hai. Qile ki teen taraf Ganga nadi ka tezz bahaav natural suraksha kavach deta hai, jabki zameeni taraf ek behad chaudi aur gehri khai (water moat) banayi gayi thi jismein Ganga ka paani bhara rehta tha. Qile ke chaaro taraf moti deewarein aur 4 mukhya darwaze hain, jinme Lal Darwaza sabse aakarshak hai. Qile ke bheetar underground tunnels (surangein) thin jo aapatkaal mein bhagne ke kaam aati thin. Yahin par Mir Qasim ka Topkhana, Pir Shah Nufa ka Mazar aur Bihar School of Yoga sthit hain.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Key Geopolitical Sentry of Bengal & Bihar / Arms Manufacturing Heritage
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Medieval Bharat mein Munger ko 'Gate of Bengal' kaha jata tha, kyunki yahan rasta roke bina koi bhi fauj water-route ya zameen se Bengal mein dakhil nahi ho sakti thi. Mir Qasim dwara shuru ki gayi bandook banane ki vidya itni pukhta thi ki azaadi ke baad tak Munger desi bandook aur arms craft ka mukhya center bana raha. Aaj is qile ke andar administrative offices aur vishv-prasiddha Bihar Yoga Bharati chalti hai, aur iski deewarein ASI dwara sanrakshit hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Pal/Tughlaq kalin neev; 1762 mein Bengal ke Nawab Mir Qasim ne isko modern armory banaya.
Teen taraf Ganga nadi se ghira rocky bastion aur zameeni taraf deep defensive moat.
Mir Qasim ne Murshidabad se rajdhani Munger shift ki, jo 1764 Battle of Buxar ka mukhya kaaran bani.
BPSC Prelims ka favourite question: 'Bengal ke kis Nawab ne apni rajdhani Murshidabad se Munger sthanantarit ki thi?' Answer: Mir Qasim.

popular_title: Gateway to Bengal (बंगाल का प्रवेश द्वार)

location.exact_spot: Ganga nadi aur Rajmahal pahadiyon ke beech ka narrow pass

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Teli Zamindar origin / Fortified by Sultanate, Sher Shah & Mughals
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Teliyagarhi qila medieval itihas mein strategic drishti se sabse critical chokepoint tha. Yeh qila ek aisi jagah par bana tha jahan Ganga nadi aur Rajmahal ki unchi pahadiyan aapas mein lagbhag judti thin, jisse beech mein sirf ek sankirn (narrow) rasta bachta tha. Delhi ya Bihar se kisi bhi sena ko Bengal mein ghusne ke liye isi darwaze se hokar gujarna padta tha, isiliye ise 'Key of Bengal' kaha jata tha. 1536 aur 1538 mein Sher Shah Suri ne Humayun aur Bengal ke Sultan Ghiyasuddin Mahmud Shah ki senaon ko yahin par trap karke unka rasta roka tha aur unpar decisively bhari pade the.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Teliyagarhi qila pahadi chattan aur kaale basalt pattharon se banaya gaya tha. Iski deewarein aisi banti thin jo pahad se niche Ganga ke kinaare tak seedhi aakar rasta seal kar deti thin. Ismein do mukhya gates the jahan topon ke moukhe bane the. Ek taraf gehra paani aur doosri taraf abhed jungle hone ke karan koi bhi sena is qile ko bypass nahi kar sakti thi; yahan mahaz 500 sainik hazaron ki sena ko mahino tak roke rakhne ki takat rakhte the.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Chokepoint of Medieval Warfare / Bengal-Bihar Military Border
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Bakhtiyar Khilji, Sher Shah, Humayun, Akbar aur Mir Jafar sabhi ke Bengal military campaigns ka faisla yahin hua. Jo Teliyagarhi jeet leta tha, Bengal par uski hukumat aasan ho jati thi. Azaadi se pehle yeh Bihar ke Bhagalpur commissionary ka mukhya sainik frontier tha. Aaj iske bache hue stone gate aur bastions railway line aur Ganga ke kinare khade hain, jo medieval military engineering ka classic namoona hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Medieval Sultanate kalin neev; 16th century mein Sher Shah Suri dwara intensively used.
Ganga nadi aur Rajmahal pahadiyon ke beech bana natural chokepoint stone fortress.
1536 aur 1538 mein Sher Shah ne Bengal campaign ke dauran is qile par niyantran karke Humayun ko chhakaya.
BPSC History: 'Medieval kal mein 'Key to Bengal' ya Bengal ka pravesh dwar kis qile ko kaha jata tha?' Answer: Teliyagarhi Qila.

location.exact_spot: Jalalgarh (Purnea shahar se 20 km uttar, Kosi basin)

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Nawab Saif Khan (Faujdar of Purnea) ya Sultan Jalaluddin / Mughal Era (c. 1722)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Jalalgarh qila 18th century ki shuruat (lagbhag 1722 CE) mein Purnea ke shaktishali Mughal Faujdar (governor) Nawab Saif Khan dwara banwaya gaya tha (kuch records iska sambandh early Sultan Jalaluddin se bhi jodte hain). Is qile ko banane ka mukhya maksad sainik aakraman nahi, balki border defense tha. Us daur mein Nepal ke Morang tarai ke pahadi luteron aur Koch kings ke hamlawaron se Bihar ki seema ko bachana zaroori tha. Nawab Saif Khan ne is qile ko ek permanent military border-post ke roop mein taiyar kiya jahan topei aur sainik har waqt taiyar rehte the.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Jalalgarh qile ka aakar aam pahadi qilon se alag poori tarah chaukor (quadrangular) hai. Yeh maidaani ilaqe mein eenton se bana ek shandar sainik kila hai jiske chaaro konon par gol gumbaddar burj (semi-circular bastions) banaye gaye the, jahan se topon se charo dishaon mein door tak nishana lagaya ja sakta tha. Qile ki deewarein lagbhag 20 foot se zyada unchi aur behad moti hain jinme sainikon ke bandook chalane ke liye chhote chhed (loop-holes) bane hain. Iska main entrance gate Indo-Islamic arch shaili mein bana hua hai aur qile ke andar ek chhoti masjid aur barracks ke avashesh bache hain.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Northern Frontier Shield of Bengal Subah / Border Defense Monument
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Mughal samrajya ke dauran Purnea Bengal Subah ka sabse sensitive border zila tha. Jalalgarh qile ke bina Nepal ke raaste aane wale aakramankariyon ko rokna asambhav tha. 1757 ke Plassey yuddh ke baad jab British East India Company ne Purnea par kabja kiya, tab unhone bhi is qile ka upyog apni military chhavani ke roop mein kiya tha. Kosi nadi ke baadh aur upksha ke bawajood iski moti eent ki deewarein aaj bhi khadi hain aur Bihar State Archaeology dwara iske restoration ka kaam chal raha hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: c. 1722 CE mein Purnea ke Mughal Faujdar Nawab Saif Khan dwara border security hetu nirmit.
Chaukor (quadrangular) brick layout, gol burj (bastions) aur Indo-Islamic arched gateway.
Nepal ke Morang tarai aakramankariyon ko rokne wala Bengal Subah ka uttari boundary check-post.
BPSC State GK: 'Jalalgarh ka aitihasik qila Bihar ke kis zile mein sthit hai?' Answer: Purnea.

popular_title: Citadel of Veer Kunwar Singh / Capital of 1857 Resistance

location.exact_spot: Jagdishpur town (Arrah se lagbhag 30 km door)

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Ujjainiya Rajput Dynasty / Babu Veer Kunwar Singh
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Jagdishpur qila medieval Ujjainiya Parmar rajput vansh ka shahi mukhya aawash tha, jise 1857 ke Great Revolt ke dauran Babu Veer Kunwar Singh ne apni azad sarkar ka administrative aur military capital banaya. Kunwar Singh ne is qile ke andar bandooke dhalne, topei banane aur barood store karne ka vishal setup lagaya tha. July 1857 mein jab Dinapur ke sipahiyon ne baghavat ki, unhone Jagdishpur qile mein aakar hi Kunwar Singh ke samne namoshish kiya aur unhein apna supreme leader maana.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Jagdishpur qila traditional brick-and-mud fortification ka namoona tha jiske charo taraf ghaney Mahua aur Aam ke bageeche aur jungle the jo natural camouflage dete the. Qile ke bheetar shahi kachehri, deewan-khana, zenana mahal aur baroodkhana bana tha. Qile ke andar se emergency ke liye secret tunnels (surangein) thin jo jungle ke raste bahar nikalti thin. Major Vincent Eyre ne August 1857 mein hamla karke iske mahalon aur mandiron ko gunpowder se uda diya tha, par unke chhapamar sainiko ne is jungle-fortress ko 1858 tak wapas capture kiya.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Sanctum Sanctorum of 1857 Freedom War in Bihar / State Protected Memorial
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Jagdishpur qila sirf ek pathar ka structure nahi balki Bihar ke aatmasamman aur British empire ke khilaf khuli lalkar ka symbol hai. Yahin se Kunwar Singh ne 80 varsh ki aayu mein Captain Le Grand ki sena ko 23 April 1858 ko dharashayi kiya tha. Vartaman mein Bihar sarkar ne yahan 'Veer Kunwar Singh Kila Parisar' aur museum vikasit kiya hai, jahan unke hathiyar aur aitihasik dharohar surakshit hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Ujjainiya Parmar rulers dwara vikasit; 1857 kranti mein Kunwar Singh ka headquarters.
Brick fortified mansion jismein underground ammunitions foundry aur secret escape tunnels thin.
23 April 1858 ko Jagdishpur mein hi Captain Le Grand ki sena ko dharashayi kiya gaya tha.
BPSC Prelims: '1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Babu Kunwar Singh ka mukhya sainik qila kahan sthit tha?' Answer: Jagdishpur (Bhojpur).

monument_name: Palamu Forts - Purana & Naya Qila (पलामू के क़िले)
popular_title: Fortress of Chero Kings / Nagpuri Gate Marvel

location.exact_spot: Auranga Nadi ke tat par, Betla National Park ke jungle mein

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Chero Kings (Raja Bhagwant Ray & Raja Medini Ray)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Palamu ke do qile—Purana Qila aur Naya Qila—Auranga nadi ke ghaney janglon ke beech khade hain. Puraney qile ka nirmarn 16th century ke aakhir mein Chero vansh ke sansthapak Raja Bhagwant Ray ne shuru kiya tha, jabki Naya Qila Chero vansh ke sabse mahan shasak Raja Medini Ray (1658–1674) ne banwaya tha. Medini Ray ka shasankal 'Chero samrajya ka golden era' maana jata tha. Aurangzeb ke Subedar Daud Khan ne 1660s mein is qile par aakraman karke Chero rajya par kabja kiya tha.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Naye qile ka sabse aakarshak feature iska 'Nagpuri Darwaza' hai, jo shandar balua patthar par bareek naqqashi se bana ek vishal mehraabdar gateway hai (kehte hain Medini Ray ise Chota Nagpur ke Nagvanshi raja ko harakar Doisa se laye the). Qile ki deewarein behad unchi aur moti hain jo pahadi ke natural slopes par bani hain. Deewaron mein bandookon aur teeron ke liye barik openings thin. Qile ke bheetar ek teen-gumbad wali masjid ke avashesh bhi hain jo Daud Khan ke kabje ke baad banwayi gayi thi.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Tribal-Rajput Syncretic Military Architecture / Protected Monument
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Palamu qila yeh sabit karta hai ki ancient aur medieval Bihar mein Chero aadiwasi rajvansh ka military engineering standard kitna uncha tha. 1857 ke dauran Nilambar aur Pitambar ne inhi qilon aur janglon ko apna guerrilla base banaya tha. Betla Tiger Reserve ke ghaney sal janglon ke beech sthit yeh monument ASI aur state heritage ke tehat ek high-value eco-historical destination hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Chero rajaon dwara 16th-17th century mein nirmit; Naya Qila Raja Medini Ray dwara banwaya gaya.
Indo-Islamic aur indigenous tribal architecture ka mishran; famous 'Nagpuri Darwaza'.
1660 CE mein Mughal general Daud Khan ne Palamu yuddh mein is qile ko jeeta tha.
BPSC History: 'Palamu qile ke prasiddha 'Nagpuri Darwaza' ka nirmarn kis Chero shasak ke daur se juda hai?' Answer: Raja Medini Ray.

monument_name: Bari Dargah Maner Sharif (बड़ी दरगाह - मनेर)
popular_title: Spiritual Cradle of Sufism in Bihar / Shrine of Yahya Maneri

location.exact_spot: Maner town, NH-30 ke paas, Son aur Ganga ke prachin sangam kshetra mein

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Delhi Sultanate & Early Mughal Patrons / Suhrawardi-Firdausi Tradition
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Maner Sharif Bihar ka sabse prachin Sufi center hai, jahan lagbhag 13vein sadi mein mahan Sufi sant Hazrat Tajuddin Khandagah aur unke suputra Hazrat Makhdoom Kamaluddin Yahya Maneri aakar base the. Kamaluddin Yahya Maneri mahan Sufi sant Makhdoom Sharfuddin Yahya Maneri (Badi Dargah Bihar Sharif) ke pita the. Kamaluddin Yahya Maneri ke inteqal ke baad unke aaram-gah par yeh Badi Dargah banayi gayi. Yahan aakar prarthana karne walon mein Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq, Sikandar Lodi aur Mughal Badshah Babur samet kayi bade shasak shamil the jinhone is dargah ko gaon aur land-grants donate kiye the.

architectural_and_structural_features.explanation: Badi Dargah ek vishal char-diwari wale aangan ke beech mein mitti ke unche teele par bani hui hai. Mukhya mazar ke charo taraf khoobsurat khambhe aur baramadah (verandah) bana hai, jismein traditional stone-carved jaliyon (perforated screens) se roshni aur hawa aati hai. Dargah ke theek samne ek behad vishal eenton se bana talab (tank) bana hua hai jise Mughal kaal mein vikasit kiya gaya tha. Iske theek paas 1616 CE mein bani 'Chhoti Dargah' (Makhdoom Daulat Shah ka maqbara) sthit hai jo pure Bihar mein Chunar balua patthar par sabse behtareen naqqashi ke liye jani jati hai.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Oldest Sufi Center of Bihar / Symbol of Ganga-Jamuni Tehzeeb
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Maner Sharif Bihar ke dharamik aur bhashayi itihas ka milestone hai kyunki yahan medieval daur mein Sanskrit, Farsi aur local Bhojpuri/Magahi ka adbhut sangam hua. Yeh sthal centuries se Hindu-Muslim amity ka jinda prateek hai jahan Urs ke mele mein sabhi dharmo ke log 'Maner ke Laddoo' ka prasad chadhate hain. Bihar Sarkar ke Sufi Tourism Circuit mein Maner Sharif ko pratham sthan diya gaya hai aur ASI iske physical heritage ko maintain karti hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 13vein sadi mein Hazrat Makhdoom Kamaluddin Yahya Maneri ki sthali ke roop mein vikasit.
Early Sultanate austere style; samne vishal stone tank aur paas mein Chhoti Dargah ka high-domed complex.
Mughal badshah Babur ne Ghaghra ladai ke baad 1529 mein Maner Sharif aakar ziarat ki thi.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar ka sabse prachin Sufi kendra kaun sa hai aur Maner Sharif kis zila mein sthit hai?' Answer: Patna.

monument_name: Chhoti Dargah / Tomb of Makhdoom Daulat Shah (छोटी दरगाह - मनेer)

location.exact_spot: Maner Sharif, Badi Dargah ke theek paschimi aangan mein

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Ibrahim Khan Kakar (Mughal Governor of Bihar under Jahangir)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Chhoti Dargah ko 1616 CE mein Bihar ke Mughal Governor Ibrahim Khan Kakar ne apne spiritual master (peer) Hazrat Makhdoom Shah Daulat ke inteqal ke baad unke aaram-gah ke roop mein banwaya tha. Hazrat Shah Daulat Maner ke mashhoor Sufi silsile ke buzurg the jinki badi aashtha thi. Ibrahim Khan Kakar ne is maqbare ko banane ke liye Chunar se behtareen shilpkaron aur balua patthar ko mangwaya tha. Jahangir ke shasankaal mein bani yeh building poore Bihar mein imperial Mughal architecture ka sabse mature aur khubsurat specimen mana jata hai.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Chhoti Dargah ek vishal unche chabutare par bani hui do-manzila square building hai, jiske upar ek bada gumbad aur charo kono par 4 aakarshak 12-sided minarets bani hain. Iski deewaron aur chhat par Quran ki aayaton aur phool-pattiyon ki aisi barik jali-work naqqashi hai jo Fatehpur Sikri ya Agra ke monuments ki barabari karti hai. Maqbare ke samne ek vishal ghat-numa stone tank (talab) hai jismein aane-jane ke liye seedhiyan aur chhatriyan hain. Iska pura compound aam dhoop mein chamakta hai aur bheetar shant thandak rehti hai.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Pinnacle of Mughal Architecture in Bihar / ASI Protected Monument
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Itihaskaron ke mutabiq Bihar mein Mughal kalin shaili ka isse zyada refined aur balance structure doosra nahi hai. Yeh structure dikhata hai ki 17th century mein Bihar Mughal empire ka kitna ahem cultural province tha. UNESCO standard ka yeh monument ASI dwara sanrakshit hai aur paryatan ke liye high-value destination hai jahan Farsi shilp aur Indian stone craft ka bejod sangam dikhta hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Mughal Subedar Ibrahim Khan Kakar dwara 1616 CE mein Hazrat Shah Daulat ke samman mein nirmit.
Chunar sandstone par classical Mughal jali-work, central dome aur charo konon par octagonal minars.
Jahangir ke shasankaal mein Mughal administrative stability ka prateek.
BPSC Prelims: 'Maner mein sthit prasiddha 'Chhoti Dargah' ka nirmarn kis Mughal Governor ne karwaya tha?' Answer: Ibrahim Khan Kakar (1616 CE).

monument_name: Malik Ibrahim Baya Tomb (मलिक इब्राहिम बया का मकबरा)

location.exact_spot: Pir Pahadi (Bihar Sharif town ke shikar par)

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq / Firoz Shah Tughlaq era (c. 1353 CE)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Yeh maqbara 14th century ke Delhi Sultanat ke mahan military commander aur Bihar ke Governor Malik Ibrahim Baya ka hai. Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq ke aadesh par Malik Baya ne Magadha kshetra mein local kshatriyon aur dakuon ke aatank ko shant karke Sultanat ke prashasan ko jamaya tha. 1353 CE mein unki shahadat ke baad unke suputra Syed Daud aur Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq ke aashirvad se Pir Pahadi ke sabse unche shikar par yeh maqbara banaya gaya tha. Yeh structure Bihar Sharif mein Islamic authority ke shuruati vistar ka sabse bada center tha.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Malik Baya ke maqbare ki sabse anokhi pehchan iski 'Sloping Walls' (dhalandar deewarein) hain, jo traditional Tughlaq architecture ki khas pehchan maani jaati hai (jaise Delhi mein Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq ka maqbara). Deewarein niche se chaudi aur upar jaate-jaate halki jhuki hui hain, jisse yeh door se dekhne par kisi qile jaisa mazboot dikhta hai. Iske upar ek bada ardh-golakar gumbad bana hai. Pir Pahadi ki choti par hone ke karan yeh charo taraf se dushmano ke hamle se surakshit tha aur yahan se poore Bihar Sharif shahar par nazar rakhi ja sakti thi.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Sole Classical Tughlaq Architecture Specimen in Bihar / ASI Protected Site
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Yeh monument pure Bihar mein Tughlaq kalin dhalan-deewar (battered walls) shaili ka akela aur sabse behtareen praman hai. Yeh batata hai ki 14th century mein Patna se pehle Bihar Sharif poore prant ka administrative capital hua karta tha (jiske naam par is rajya ka naam 'Bihar' pada). ASI ke sanrakshan mein yeh pahadi par sthit ek prasiddha heritage aur pilgrimage landmark hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 1353 CE (14th century) mein Tughlaq kaal ke doran Malik Ibrahim Baya ki yaad mein nirmit.
Classical Tughlaq style jismein dhalandar (battered/sloping) eent ki deewarein aur central dome hai.
Muhammad bin Tughlaq ke daur mein Bihar Sharif ko Magadha ka administrative headquarters banane ka symbol.
BPSC Prelims: 'Bihar Sharif mein Pir Pahadi par sthit Malik Ibrahim Baya ka maqbara kis shaili ka namoona hai?' Answer: Tughlaq Architecture.

monument_name: Saif Khan's Madrasa & Mosque (सैफ़ ख़ान का मदरसा एवं मस्जिद)
popular_title: Ganga Riverfront University of Mughal Patna

location.exact_spot: Patna City, Ganga nadi ke dakshini unche kinare par

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Nawab Saif Khan (Mughal Governor of Bihar & husband of Malika Banu)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Yeh vishal educational complex 1629-1630 CE mein Mughal Badshah Shah Jahan ke shasankaal mein Bihar ke Governor Nawab Saif Khan ne banwaya tha (jo Mumtaz Mahal ke behnoi the). Saif Khan ne Patna ko Farsi sahitya, kanoon, ganit aur Islamic philosophy ka sabse bada center banane ke liye is shandar madrasa aur mosque ka nirmarn karwaya tha. Yahan door-door se aane wale talib-e-ilm (students) aur vidwano ke rehne aur khane ka shahi prabandh tha. 17th aur 18th century mein yeh North India ke premier academic institutions mein gina jata tha.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Yeh complex Ganga nadi ke theek kinare ek vishal terrace platform par bana hua hai. Iske do-manzila arched rooms the jo chhatron aur aacharyon ke hostel kaksh the. Masjid ke upar teen shandar gumbad bane hain aur iska arched gateway Ganga nadi ke taraf khulta tha jahan se shahi naav aakar lagti thi. Deewaron par plaster par lajawab chitrakaari aur geometric floral patterns bane the. Ganga ke unche tat par hone ki wajah se yeh baadh ke paani se surakshit rehta tha aur wahan se nadi ka shant nazara dikhta tha.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: Premier Mughal Educational Institution / Riverfront Architectural Heritage
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Saif Khan ka madrasa yeh darshata hai ki Mughal daur mein Azimabad (Patna) sirf vyapar ka hi nahi balki ucch shiksha ka bhi kitna bada center tha. French traveler Tavernier aur Peter Mundy ne is madrasa ki vishalta aur shiksha pranali ki tareef apne yatra-vrittanto mein ki thi. Vartaman mein iske bache hue hisse ASI aur state protection ke under hain jo prachin Azimabad ki intellectual shaan ko darshate hain.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: 1629-1630 CE mein Mughal Governor Nawab Saif Khan dwara banwaya gaya.
Do-manzila arched madrasa compound, three-domed mosque aur Ganga riverfront facade.
Shah Jahan ke daur mein Patna (Azimabad) ko academic center banane ka supreme effort.
BPSC History: 'Patna City mein Ganga tat par sthit aitihasik Saif Khan ka madrasa kis Mughal shasak ke kaal mein bana tha?' Answer: Shah Jahan (Governor Saif Khan, 1629 CE).

popular_title: Stone Mosque of Prince Parwez / Saif Khan's Mosque

location.exact_spot: Patna City, Takht Sri Patna Sahib ke kareeb, Ganga tat ke paas

builder_and_historical_context.patron_or_builder: Prince Parwez (Mughal Emperor Jahangir ke putra)
builder_and_historical_context.explanation: Pathar ki Masjid Patna City ke sabse purane Mughal dharoharo mein se ek hai, jise 1621 CE mein Mughal Badshah Jahangir ke doosre bete Shahzada Parwez ne banwaya tha. Shahzada Parwez Bihar ke pehle Mughal rajkumar the jinhe yahan ka Governor banakar Patna bheja gaya tha, aur unke rehne ke dauran hi Patna ki administrative shaan bohot badh gayi thi. Yeh masjid local shia aur sunni community ke liye ek prathisthit upasana sthal bani aur isne Patna mein eenton ke bajaye patthar se imaarat banane ki shuruaat ki.

architectural_and_defensive_design.explanation: Aamtaur par Patna ke zyadatar medieval structures eenton (lakhori bricks) se bane hain, lekin is masjid ki poori building kaale-bhoore balua patthar (sandstone) ke vishal thakhton ko jod kar banayi gayi hai, isiliye ise 'Pathar ki Masjid' ya 'Sangi Masjid' kaha jata hai. Iske aage teen arched pravesh dwar hain jinke upar traditional Mughal floral motifs ukeri gayi hain. Iska structure compact, solid aur plain hai, jismein kisi unchi minaret ke bajaye chhat ke charo konon par chhote minarets bane hain jo isko ek shaant aur mazboot roop dete hain.

strategic_and_heritage_value.core_importance: First Royal Mughal Prince Building in Patna / Historic Stone Monument
strategic_and_heritage_value.explanation: Yeh imaarat is baat ka praman hai ki 17th century ki shuruat mein jab Mughal princes ko Bihar ka subedar banaya jane laga, tab Patna ka status provincial town se uthkar ek royal Mughal capital level par aa gaya tha. Shahzada Parwez ka darbar yahin chalta tha. Yeh masjid aam nagarikon ke dharamik aashtha ka kendra hone ke sath-sath ASI dwara state-level protected historical monument hai.

exam_facts_and_pyqs.detail: Jahangir ke bete Shahzada Parwez dwara 1621 CE mein sthapit.
Poori tarah patthar se bani central arched stone facade bina badi minaron ke.
Mughal princes ke direct Patna viceroyalty ka pratham physical monument.
BPSC Prelims: 'Patna mein sthit 'Pathar ki Masjid' ka nirmarn kis Mughal rajkumar ne karwaya tha?' Answer: Shahzada Parwez (1621 CE).
